sections.intro: Frappe development means building business software on the Frappe Framework, either as a new standalone app or as an extension that runs alongside ERPNext. It covers data models, forms, workflows, reports, APIs and web portals. A focused app usually takes 6–12 weeks, and a large multi-module app takes 3–6 months. Our Frappe development services cover five types of work:
rows: Rental, service or lab management systems
New modules that share ERPNext data and users
Connections to mobile apps, stores or partner systems
Customer, supplier or dealer self-service pages
Moving older apps to the current Frappe version
sections.note: As a Frappe development company Kochi firms can visit in person, we start every project with a technical scoping call, so the data model is right before we write code.

sections.h2: Why Build on the Frappe Framework?

paragraphs.text: Frappe gives developers ready-made building blocks: DocTypes for data, role-based permissions, a REST API, background jobs, reports, print formats and a web interface. Because these are built in, Frappe framework development is often faster than starting from an empty Python or JavaScript project.
Five reasons our clients choose Frappe:

items.html: 1. Faster delivery. Forms, lists, permissions and APIs come ready, so effort goes into your business logic.
2. Open source. Frappe is released under the MIT licence, with no fee per user.
3. Works with ERPNext. Your app can share customers, items and users with ERPNext.
4. Python and JavaScript. Skills are widely available, so you are never tied to one vendor.
5. Flexible hosting. Run it on Frappe Cloud, AWS or your own server.

outro.text: That is why a Frappe development company Kochi startups and SMEs hire can usually deliver a first working version in weeks, not months.

sections.intro: Custom Frappe app development suits processes that standard software cannot handle well. Our Frappe application development work includes:

items.html: Operations apps: equipment rental, service contracts, fleet tracking and maintenance schedules
Industry apps: lab sample registers, school fee management and clinic workflows
Sales tools: dealer ordering, quotation builders and commission tracking
Internal tools: approval desks, document registers and task boards

outro.text: Each project uses Frappe module development practices: clean DocTypes, clear permissions and tests for core logic. Our Frappe software development follows the same standards whether the app has two forms or twenty.

paragraphs.html: Many projects connect Frappe to the outside world. Frappe API development lets mobile apps, online stores and partner systems read and write data securely. For connecting ERPNext to WooCommerce, Shopify or payment gateways, see our ERPNext integration services page.

paragraphs.text: Frappe portal development gives customers, suppliers or dealers their own login to place orders, download invoices or raise requests. For full browser-based tools, our Frappe web app development uses Frappe UI and Vue for modern, fast screens.

paragraphs.html: Mobile access is possible too. We build progressive web apps on Frappe, or connect a native app through the API. For native app builds, our Mobile App Development team works with the Frappe team.

sections.h2: Dedicated Frappe Developers for Your Team

paragraphs.text: If you already run ERPNext or Frappe and have an internal IT lead, you can add Frappe dedicated developers by the month. They join your stand-ups, use your Git repository and follow your review process.

Our Frappe framework developers have experience with DocTypes, hooks, server scripts, background jobs and the REST API. Every Frappe Python developer on our team works in Python and JavaScript, and each Frappe ERP developer also understands accounting, stock and selling flows in ERPNext. That mix matters, because most business apps touch financial data.

You own everything we build. Your contract states that the code, the database and the documentation belong to you from day one. We keep custom work in separate apps and never edit Frappe or ERPNext core code, so upgrades stay safe.

paragraphs.html: This is the standard a Frappe development company Kochi clients trust should commit to in writing. For changes inside an existing ERPNext setup, such as fields, workflows or print formats, see ERPNext customization.

items.a: Frappe is used to build business software such as ERP systems, CRMs, helpdesks, HR tools and custom operations apps. ERPNext itself is built on Frappe, so any Frappe app development can share data with ERPNext.

items.q: Can you build a separate app that runs with ERPNext?
items.a: Yes. We build custom apps that install alongside ERPNext and share its customers, items, users and permissions. Because the app is separate, ERPNext upgrades do not overwrite it.
Yes. The code, database and documentation belong to you, and this is written into the contract. You can host the app anywhere and work with any developer later.

items.q: Do you offer monthly Frappe developers?
items.a: Yes. You can add one or more dedicated developers by the month. They work in your Git repository and join your team's meetings and reviews.

items.q: How long does a custom Frappe app take?
items.a: A focused app with a few forms and reports takes 6–12 weeks. Larger apps with portals, integrations and many roles take 3–6 months. We break big projects into phases so you can use the first release early.

items.q: Is Frappe a better choice than a fully custom build?
items.a: For most business apps, yes. Frappe already handles logins, permissions, forms, reports and APIs, so you pay only for your own logic. A good Frappe development company Kochi teams consult should still tell you when a different stack fits better, and we do.

items.q: Can you take over an existing Frappe app?
items.a: Yes. We review the code, document how it works, fix urgent issues and move any core edits into a proper custom app. Then we can continue development or support it monthly.
